title: External pack contract — views
intro: Proposed: how a skill pack outside Grove's repository joins the methodology, with ResearchSkills as the first pack. A review-design leaf reads the contract before the runner work. Graphs begin at Start here; numbered edges give the order of the steps.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: One plugin layout for every pack: the plugin directory is the Ravel source directory and the Claude Code plugin root.

groups.title: References between skills
groups.description: Directed loads by bare name, inside one pack and across packs, and the outcome of a missing loaded skill.

groups.title: Conformance
groups.description: Each repository checks its own working tree against a pinned revision of the other, with Grove's runner and no copy.

groups.title: Distribution
groups.description: The native marketplace, the Ravel directory route and the manual installer, each from the published pack.

discussion.title: External pack contract for ResearchSkills
discussion.summary: external-pack-contract-k155 settled the layout, the family skill, the references, the conformance runs, the distribution and the checkout identity. The proof leaves record the proven facts.

diagrams.title: One source directory, three readers
diagrams.caption: plugins/research is the Ravel source directory and the Claude Code plugin root. The repository root holds what the pack does not deliver.

diagrams.title: Directed loads of the research kinds
diagrams.caption: Amber nodes ship in ResearchSkills and blue nodes ship in core. Each research kind loads the spine across packs. The pair also loads its family skill inside the pack. A loaded skill that is absent sends the session to the launch prompt's rule.

diagrams.title: Two checks, each against a pinned revision
diagrams.caption: Grove checks its working tree against the pack commit that its marketplace pins. The pack checks its working tree against a recorded Grove commit and runs that commit's runner.

diagrams.title: Three routes from one published commit
diagrams.caption: The native install brings the grove plugin through the dependency. The Ravel route reads a checkout that a tool outside Ravel made. The installer takes the pack's plugin directory.
